routes.name: Visa-free short visit (Short-Term Visit Pass)
routes.summary: Most nationalities not on ICA's visa-required list can enter without a visa and get a short-term pass on arrival. Everyone must submit the free SG Arrival Card online before arriving. Exact stay length was not confirmed on the pages read.

other: Visa-free stay length and the business-visit rules were not stated on the pages read. Check ICA before travel.
Submit the SG Arrival Card online ahead of arrival. It is free.

routes.name: Short-term visit visa (visa-required nationalities)
routes.summary: Citizens of the listed countries, and holders of certain travel documents, must get a visa before coming. ICA charges S$30 for the visa.

other: Also required for refugee travel documents, alien's passports, Palestinian Authority passports, UAE temporary passports, Hong Kong Document of Identity, Macao Travel Permit and PRC Travel Document.
Allowed stay and application steps were not confirmed on the pages read.

routes.name: Short-Term Visit Pass extension
routes.summary: You can extend a visit online if your pass has 14 days or less left. ICA decides case by case and can grant a further 30 days, or up to 89 days total from entry.

other: A local sponsor (Singapore citizen or PR aged 21+) is needed if you have immediate family who are citizens or PRs, or hold a passport from a listed country.
Malaysian visitors follow a separate 60/90-day rule.

steps: Apply online before the pass expires, with 14 days or less left.

routes.name: Transit through Singapore
routes.summary: ICA has a Visa Free Transit Facility for some travelers connecting through Changi. The rules and hours were not shown on the pages read.

other: Qualifying nationalities, permitted hours and airside rules not confirmed. Check ICA's Visa Free Transit Facility page.

routes.name: Employment Pass (EP)
routes.summary: For foreign professionals, managers and executives. You need to meet the age-based minimum salary and, unless exempt, 40 COMPASS points.

income.note: Minimum at youngest ages for non-financial sectors, rising with age (up to S$10,700 in mid-40s). From 1 Jan 2027 new applications: S$6,000 rising to S$11,500 at age 45+. Financial services: S$6,600 to S$12,700.

other: COMPASS needs 40 points (salary, qualifications, firm diversity, local employment support, skills bonus, strategic priorities bonus).
Exempt from COMPASS: salary of S$22,500+ a month, overseas intra-corporate transferees, or roles of 1 month or less.
Employer must advertise on MyCareersFuture first.

stay.note: First pass up to 2 years, renewals up to 3 years. Up to 5 years for experienced tech professionals in shortage skills.

steps: Employer advertises the job on MyCareersFuture.
Check eligibility with the EP Self-Assessment Tool.

routes.name: S Pass
routes.summary: For mid-skilled technicians and associate professionals who may not meet EP criteria. Employers face a quota and levy.

income.note: Minimum, rising with age to S$4,800 in mid-40s. New applications from 1 Jan 2027: S$3,600. Financial services need more.

other: Subject to employer quota and levy. Amounts not on the pages read.

stay.note: First pass up to 2 years, renewals up to 3 years.

routes.name: Work Permit (semi-skilled)
routes.summary: For semi-skilled workers from approved source countries in certain sectors. Sector rules, quotas and levies apply. Domestic workers use a separate permit.

other: Approved countries, sectors, levy and validity were not shown on the page read. Check MOM sector-specific rules.

routes.name: Overseas Networks & Expertise (ONE) Pass
routes.summary: A 5-year pass for top earners and outstanding achievers. You can work for or run several companies without changing passes.

income.note: Fixed monthly salary for 12 consecutive months at an established company (US$500m market cap or US$200m revenue), or an offer at that level. Single employer only.

other: Outstanding achievers in sports, arts and culture, or academia and research have no salary test.
New AI and Tech track from 28 Jan 2027: total pay S$30,000 a month (S$22,500 fixed), 5 years in founder, C-suite or tech roles in the past 10 years, at a qualifying tech employer.
Renewal: S$30,000 average monthly salary over 5 years, or run a Singapore firm with at least 5 local employees.
Exempt from COMPASS. Must report activities and income to MOM by 31 January yearly.

stay.note: 5 years, and 5 years on each renewal.

routes.name: EntrePass
routes.summary: For founders of venture-backed or innovative tech private limited companies registered with ACRA. You must hold at least 30%.

investment.note: One option: raise at least S$100,000 in a single funding round.

other: Meet one of: S$100,000 funding round, backing by a recognized incubator or accelerator, a prior exit, registered IP, or a research collaboration with a Singapore institution.
Coffee shops, bars, massage parlours, employment agencies and geomancy businesses are not eligible.

stay.note: New pass and first renewal up to 1 year. Later renewals up to 2 years.

routes.name: Tech.Pass
routes.summary: For established tech founders and leaders. Closing: from 28 Jan 2027 MOM and EDB stop accepting new and renewal applications. The ONE Pass AI and Tech track replaces it.

income.note: Last drawn fixed monthly salary in the past year.

other: At least 5 years in a leading role within the past 10 years at a tech company valued at US$500m+ (or that raised US$30m+), or a tech VC firm with US$500m+ AUM.
Renewal needs one of: S$270,000 assessable income, S$100,000 yearly business spend plus local hires, or a Singapore tech company that raised over US$10m in 36 months.

stay.note: 2 years, renewable for another 2. Closes to new and renewal applications from 28 Jan 2027.

routes.name: Dependant's Pass (DP)
routes.summary: For the legally married spouse and unmarried children under 21 (including legally adopted) of EP, S Pass or similar pass holders.

other: EP holder must earn at least S$6,000 a month for family passes.
Valid for the main pass duration or the period requested, whichever is shorter. No levy or quota.
Work rights depend on the pass type and eligibility, check MOM.

stay.note: Matches the main pass holder's validity.

routes.name: Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP)
routes.summary: For common-law spouses, unmarried stepchildren under 21, unmarried disabled children 21 and over, and parents of EP or S Pass holders. Parents need a main holder earning over S$12,000 a month.

income.note: Main pass holder's pay, for parents only.

other: Validity and work rights were not shown on the pages read.

routes.name: Student's Pass
routes.summary: Needed for full-time study at a Singapore institution. ICA's requirements and steps differ by type of school. Details were not shown on the page read.

other: Requirements, fees, validity and work rights not confirmed. Check ICA by institution type.

routes.name: Work Holiday Pass
routes.summary: A 6-month, non-renewable pass for students and recent graduates to work and holiday. Capped at 2,000 holders at a time. No family passes.

eligibility.education: Undergraduate or graduate of a recognized university
other: Undergraduates must have been residents and full-time students of their university for at least 3 months before applying.
No foreign worker levy.

routes.name: Global Investor Programme (GIP)
routes.summary: Permanent residence for global investors with a substantial business track record. Run by EDB's Contact Singapore. Investment amounts were not shown on the page read.

other: Needs a substantial entrepreneurial track record.
Investment thresholds not confirmed. Check the GIP factsheet or EDB enquiry form.

steps: Download the GIP factsheet and forms from EDB.
Complete the e-application forms and Form 4.
Fill in the family background sheet.
Pay the ICA fee when asked.

routes.name: Permanent Residence (EP or S Pass holder)
routes.summary: EP and S Pass holders can apply for PR with no sponsor. ICA weighs economic contributions, qualifications, age, family ties and length of stay.

other: Minimum years of work pass residence were not stated on the page read.

routes.processing: ICA says generally within 6 months if documents are complete. Some take longer.

routes.name: Permanent Residence (family of citizen or PR)
routes.summary: Spouse of a Singapore citizen or PR, unmarried child under 21 of a citizen or PR, and aged parent of a citizen (child aged 21+) can apply with that relative as sponsor.

other: Sponsor must be a Singapore citizen or PR as listed.
Male applicants must check National Service obligations with CMPB before applying.

routes.processing: Generally within 6 months if all documents are submitted.

routes.name: Permanent Residence (student)
routes.summary: Students in Singapore who passed a national exam (PSLE, GCE N/O/A Levels) or are in the Integrated Programme can apply with no sponsor.

other: Other conditions were not detailed on the page read.

routes.name: Singapore Citizenship (naturalization and family routes)
routes.summary: PRs aged 21+ with at least 2 years as a PR can apply with no sponsor. A PR married to a citizen for at least 2 years applies with the spouse as sponsor. Unmarried children under 21 of citizens apply with a citizen parent sponsor. Language and test rules were not shown on the page read.

other: Dual citizenship is not confirmed from the pages read. ICA lists the question in its FAQ but the answer was not shown.
Male applicants must check National Service obligations with CMPB. Defaulting can mean a fine up to S$10,000, up to 3 years in jail, or both.
ICA assesses family ties, economic contribution, qualifications, age and length of residency.

citizenship.note: At least 2 years as a PR. Dual citizenship rule not confirmed.

routes.processing: ICA says generally within 12 months. Overseas-born children of citizens within 1 month if documents are in order.

fees.label: Application per adult or PR child
